name: Tobramycin (ophthalmic)
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: Mild to moderate: half-inch ribbon 2 or 3 times daily. Severe: every 3 to 4 hours until improvement, then taper (label)

common: Local eye reactions: lid itching and swelling, conjunctival redness (under 3%)
serious: Hypersensitivity, including anaphylaxis; Stevens-Johnson syndrome, erythema multiforme (postmarketing)

sources.citation: Novartis Pharmaceuticals Corporation. (2026). TOBREX (tobramycin ophthalmic ointment) 0.3% [Prescribing information; US FDA-approved label, NDA050555, set ID 5b66bba3-cf97-4a9c-b618-ba5f277f20f6, version effective October 26, 2026]. DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine.
